main_body: A three-tier votive stand: three thin grey shelf slabs, each carrying candles, with a dark base slab and frame uprights below
top_band: Each shelf is a 1-row light grey line (L=170) followed by a 1-row dark line (L=61), so there is no real top surface, only a 1-row edge
evidence: The column scan shows each shelf as a 1px light line over a 1px dark line, which is a rim only and not a horizontal surface. The candles are drawn face-on and the dark frame behind is a flat vertical panel. The lowest base is also a 1px light line over a dark row. No tier shows a top surface from above with a front face below, so it reads as a front elevation with thin ledges.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 11 distinct colours against 38-40 in the references. The shelves use two flat tones (light grey and dark grey), and the candles are tiny 3-4 colour sprites. The piece is under one tile, so there is no per-tile median. Texture and grain are minimal, and shading depth is clearly below Beodeul's 5-6 steps. The dark edges are mostly tinted (9% neutral), but the shallow shading and low colour count make it thinner than the references.
